question: T12 (task-49f49467587a2110): on the desktop, which blocks follow a Scrolling block's foot up when Wave Intensity falls by two steps or more, by a drag that jumps there in one move or by a press; is a block that starts above the old foot left, as on a one-step fall (CAP-T12TOPFALL P, CAP-T12DRAGFALL WD)? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and two Text blocks added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26, 1/2/3/10, 1/2/3/10); 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand. Every plan places the second Text block at 8/2/10/10 first, then selects the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'). A number is a press on Wave Intensity (180: the range's end). A drag is a mouse drag through one DevTools session, one move per value 300 ms apart, a quick read 80 ms after each move, let go right after the last; no touch emulation. JA: 90, a drag 90>120>150>180>90 (back to 90 in one move); JB: 90, a drag 90>120>150>180>120>180; JC: 90, a drag 90>120>150>180>0; JD: 90, a drag 90>120>150>90; JE: presses 90, 180, 120; JF: 90, 180, 90; JG: 90, 180, 0. JH and JI: 180, then Escape and a press on the page (go), the first Text block placed at 3/2/5/10 (JH) or 6/2/8/10 (JI), open, then a press on 90 (JH) or 120 (JI); JJ: as JI with a drag 180>120 in one move in place of the press. Then go and Cmd+Z until as built. Written as predictions first (predictions.txt in the lane folder: JA to JC first, then JD to JG, then JH to JJ to tell two rules apart). R1 ran JA JB JC, JD JE JF JG, JH JI JJ in three sessions; R2 JJ, JI JH JG JF, JE JD JC, JB JA in four. Exit without saving each time.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: On the desktop a fall of Wave Intensity leaves a block that starts above the old foot while it starts on or above the new foot, and takes it up by the foot's fall once the new foot is above its top; a press and a drag that jumps there in one move do the same, and the size of the fall does not decide it. The second Text block (under the old foot) follows the foot up in every plan.

Drags (90 pressed first: 1/2/5/26, the first Text block 3/2/5/10, the second 10/2/12/10; out to 180: 1/2/7/26, 5/2/7/10, 12/2/14/10, 13 rows). JA 180>90 in one move: 1/2/4/26 (3 rows for a line that needs 4, as a press fall of two steps), the first Text block up to 2/2/4/10 (the new foot 4 is above its top 5), the second 9/2/11/10, 10 rows. JB 180>120 in one move: 1/2/5/26, the first stays 5/2/7/10 (it starts on the new foot), the second 10/2/12/10, 11 rows; out to 180 again takes both down by 2 (7/2/9/10, 12/2/14/10, 13 rows). JD 150>90 in one move (from 1/2/6/26, the first at 4/2/6/10): 1/2/4/26, the first stays 4/2/6/10, the second 9/2/11/10, 10 rows.

Presses on the same layout: JE 90, 180, 120: at 120 1/2/5/26 and the first stays 5/2/7/10, the second 10/2/12/10, 11 rows (as JB). JF 90, 180, 90: 1/2/4/26, the first 2/2/4/10, the second 9/2/11/10, 10 rows (as JA, and as CAP-T12TOPFALL Q).

Telling the rules apart: JH, the first Text block placed at 3/2/5/10 under 1/2/7/26 (180), a press on 90: 1/2/4/26 and it stays 3/2/5/10 (a fall of 90 px, but it starts above the new foot 4); the second 9/2/11/10. JI, it placed at 6/2/8/10, a press on 120: 1/2/5/26 and it goes up by 2 to 4/2/6/10 (a fall of 60 px, but the new foot 5 is above its top 6); the second 10/2/12/10, 11 rows. JJ, JI by a drag 180>120 in one move: the same, held 80 ms after the move and after the let go.

Falls to 0 (JC by a drag 180>0 in one move, JG by presses 90, 180, 0): the Scrolling block 1/2/2/26 (1 row), the first Text block lands on the foot at 2/2/4/10 (the plain move would take it above the top row, as CAP-T12TOPFALL), and the second goes up by the first's move, 3 rows, to 9/2/11/10, not by the foot's 5 (7/2/9/10); 10 rows. Not built here.

Escape keeps every area; each drag and each press is one undo step: Cmd+Z takes back the drag or the press, then the place and earlier steps one by one. R1 and R2 read alike in every read (areas, rows, line, Undo and Redo), held reads too.
Not read: the phone view, a block that starts above the old foot and ends above it on a fall, a drag fall after a pause of a second or more, two blocks above the old foot.
